content.comment_body: Dear [company_name], Could you provide information on the voltage threshold for the input of a [product_name] [version_no]? Specifically, I need to know the difference between the high and low thresholds. I've received several unexpected notifications from my BM indicating that an input-triggered event occurred when it actually did not. I'm troubleshooting the issue and suspect that voltage fluctuations on the input might be the cause. Thank you for your help.
The answer can be found in the manual.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking clarification regarding voltage thresholds for digital inputs on a [product_name] controller, as they are experiencing false input event notifications possibly due to input voltage fluctuations. Documentation is referenced as a source, but not initially clear to the user.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects straightforward documentation or details clarifying the exact voltage threshold differentiating high and low input states, in order to troubleshoot and resolve erroneous event notifications.
